description: Grafana Labs provides observability software for dashboards, metrics, logs, traces, profiling, testing, and incident response across Grafana Cloud and self-managed Grafana. The platform includes Grafana itself plus related components such as Loki, Mimir, Tempo, Pyroscope, Alloy, and k6.
summary: Grafana.com exposes a documented Grafana Cloud REST API on `https://grafana.com/api`, tenant-specific Grafana instance HTTP APIs, a self-hostable Grafana MCP server, and CLIs including `k6` cloud mode and `gcx`.
